subject: reasoning
question: I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only two people sit between Q and K when counted from the right of Q. Only two people sit between K and O. Only three people sit between Q and P. I sits to the immediate left of L. Who sits third to the left of J?
solution:
I, J, K, L, O, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

 
• Only two people sit between Q and K when counted from the right of Q.
 
• Only two people sit between K and O.
 
• Only three people sit between Q and P
